Radical acceptance is recognizing reality without approval, passivity, or giving up.

## Turning the Mind {#turning-the-mind}

Turning the mind is the repeated choice to move from rejection toward acceptance.

## Willingness {#willingness}

Willingness means doing what the situation calls for without adding avoidable resistance.

## Willing Hands {#willing-hands}
